description: CKEditor plugin for handling fake objects, including creation and restoration of fake elements representing real DOM elements within the editor.

methods.name: createFakeElement
methods.description: Creates a fake image element representing a real DOM element with specified attributes.

methods.name: createFakeParserElement
methods.description: Creates a fake image element with HTML content representing a real DOM element.

methods.name: restoreRealElement
methods.description: Restores the original DOM element from a fake element.
